# VK Video

> VK Video is the video platform and support hub for VK services including calls, messaging, communities, and payments.

VK Video provides comprehensive support resources and documentation for users of the VK (ВКонтакте) platform. The site serves as a central hub for help documentation, FAQs, and legal information related to VK services and user obligations.

## Key Topics

- VK (ВКонтакте)
- VK Calls (VK Звонки)
- Support & Help
- FAQ
- Messaging
- Communities
- Payments
- Profile Management
- Moderation
- Terms of Service
- User Obligations
- Legal Agreements
- Site Policies
- VK Platform

## Support & Help

- [Support | VK](https://vkvideo.ru/support): FAQ and support center for VK services including calls, messaging, communities

## Legal & Terms

- [Terms of Service | VK](https://vkvideo.ru/terms): Legal terms of service and user obligations for VK platform
